items.title: Joe Loyacano Interview, 1959-08-20
items.q: Woodrow lived right around the corner from me.

ctx.x: Were there many musicians in the neighborhood? In this neighborhood? No, in that neighborhood when you were growing up. Did you know many guys right from the...
I knew the Majotas lived right around the corner from me. Woodrow lived right around the corner from me.
Seems like a lot of people came from this neighborhood who played music. Yeah.
